findings:
🔴 [stray-root-tracked-txt] MUST-FIX The commit adds a root-level `tracked.txt` (four `rel-child` lines), which is outside Allowed files ("touch no other file"). It is residue of the "relative tracked write" case writing into the real repo: `ts_snapshot_build "$fx" "$snap"` is unchecked and `cd "$snap/repo"` has no failure guard, so when build fails (as in the RED runs) `printf 'rel-child\n' >>tracked.txt` lands in the runner's cwd. Impact: the suite meant to prove write containment itself pollutes the real repo. Smallest fix: drop `tracked.txt` from the commit, and in that case use `ts_snapshot_build ... || fail ...` plus `cd "$snap/repo" || exit 1` before the relative write.
🟠 [parallel-bypasses-snapshot] MUST-FIX `hooks/tests/run.sh` adds a `_ts_preview_parallel` branch that sends any `--parallel` run to `__ts_inplace_wrap` with no `test-snapshot: disabled` line. G3 makes snapshot the default with `AUTOPILOT_TEST_SNAPSHOT=0` as the only opt-out (rsync-missing aside), and the row's Verify is "full `run.sh --parallel 16` both modes". Impact: the normal full run executes in place against the real repo, so KR1 containment is silently absent. Smallest fix: delete the `_ts_preview_parallel` scan and its `elif`, so `--parallel` takes the outer flow and argv passes through to the inner run.
🟠 [child-not-own-process-group] MUST-FIX The child is started as `( ... ) &` with neither `set -m` nor `setsid`, so in a non-interactive script it stays in the outer's process group; G3 and the brief require its own group. Impact: `kill -- "-$TS_CHILD_PID"` targets a non-existent group, and bash starts the async child with SIGINT ignored, so the inner run.sh can no longer trap INT ("behave exactly as today" breaks). On Ctrl-C the outer just waits for the whole suite to finish. Smallest fix: start the child under `set -m` (then `set +m`) or via `setsid`, keeping it a waited child.
🟠 [outer-tests-inherit-optout] MUST-FIX The two "real outer run.sh" cases in `hooks/tests/test-snapshot.test.sh` unset `AUTOPILOT_TEST_SNAPSHOT_ROOT` but not `AUTOPILOT_TEST_SNAPSHOT`. In the required opt-out Verify run, the inherited `AUTOPILOT_TEST_SNAPSHOT=0` makes the fixture runner go in place. Impact: "exit 0", "REPO_ROOT is not fixture", "under private TMPDIR" and "config unchanged" all go red in that mode. Smallest fix: add `-u AUTOPILOT_TEST_SNAPSHOT` to the `env` invocation of the success and non-zero-child cases.
🔵 [git-wrapper-hardcoded-path] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The alternates fail-closed case hardcodes `real=/usr/bin/git` in its wrapper; resolving the real git with `command -v git` before prepending PATH would be portable. Excluded because it passes on the target Linux environment.
🔵 [fixture-real-domain-email] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The outer-run fixtures set local `user.email` to `owner@stranity.com` to get past the baseline check, where the brief says to commit with an example.invalid identity. Unsetting the local email and committing with `-c user.email=...@example.invalid` would avoid a real-domain address in tests. Excluded because the fixture commits never leave TEST_TMP.
🔵 [outer-signal-traps-early] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The outer INT/TERM traps (`__ts_outer_on_interrupt`) are P4b scope and are installed after the child is spawned. Leave the rework to P4b once the process-group fix lands.
